_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (1% breakout frequency) and absent macro liquidity engine make HOLD the only statistically defensible call; a move to Disbelief requires confirmation from funding, reserves, or stablecoin growth, not just a pattern match.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken analog structure; narrative implies forward upside via accumulation framing. The split is real: the analyst's factor pattern read (trust 7.67) overrides the narrative's story framing (trust 6.00) because the evidence strongly contradicts the bullish lean.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding spikes >0.015% with exchange reserves dropping below 90 and stablecoin growth >70 signaling accumulation breakout; or VIX >20 with DXY >101 and funding negative signaling risk-off flush — either directional breaker with volume confirmation.
next_move.invalidated_if: Score holds 55-62 for next 2-3 windows with funding and CVD flat — the coil continues and any directional call was wrong by definition.
